title: t3: a three-way comparison of two token counts (fo vs ni)
label: verified
behavior: BOS + 5 tokens from {fo, le, ni, pe, ti}; at the last position the model outputs one of J / V / Y.
summary: The model outputs the sign of (number of 'fo' tokens minus number of 'ni' tokens): more fo -> J, more ni -> V, tie -> Y. The tokens le, pe, ti and all token positions are irrelevant. Five of the 15 components implement it: mlp0, heads 1.1 and 1.2, mlp1, mlp2. Head 1.1 carries the fo count and head 1.2 the ni count (double dissociation); all three MLPs are individually necessary. The other 10 heads (all of layer 0, 1.0, 1.3, all of layer 2) can be mean-ablated together with no change. All numbers are from the local-full backend (full precision). Verified on held-out data: 200/200 agreement, circuit ablated -> accuracy 0.29 (chance), everything else ablated -> accuracy 1.0.

claims.text: The model does the task deterministically: clean accuracy 1.0 on 200 prompts (local-full).
The function is sign(count(fo) - count(ni)) -> J / V / Y; a predict() implementing exactly this matches the model on 200/200 held-out inputs (null agreement p95 = 0.39).
Among attention heads only 1.1 and 1.2 take part: jointly mean-ablating the other 10 heads leaves the metric at 1.0, while jointly ablating 1.1 and 1.2 leaves 0.08.

Head 1.1 carries the fo count and head 1.2 the ni count: on ni-free prompts ablating 1.1 gives 0.0 and 1.2 gives 1.0; on fo-free prompts ablating 1.2 gives 0.0 and 1.1 gives 1.0. Consistent with this, 1.1 splits its attention equally over BOS and the fo positions (1/3 each with two fo), so the BOS weight encodes 1/(1+#fo).
All three MLP layers are individually necessary: mean-ablating mlp0, mlp1 or mlp2 leaves -0.02, 0.0 and 0.002 of the clean metric.

The circuit {mlp0, 1.1, 1.2, mlp1, mlp2} is necessary and sufficient under mean ablation: circuit ablated -> metric -0.02, accuracy 0.29; the other 10 components ablated -> metric 1.0, accuracy 1.0; all effects beat their null controls.

nodes.label: mlp0: prepares token features read by layer 1 (role inferred from necessity only)
head 1.1: attends BOS + fo -> fo count
mlp2: compares the counts (stage 2), writes J / V / Y

limitations: Which components are in the circuit is causally established; the internal division of labour between mlp0, mlp1 and mlp2 is not. The edges mlp0 -> heads and mlp1 -> mlp2 follow from layer order and necessity, not from path patching.
The attention pattern of 1.2 was not inspected directly; its ni-counter role rests on the ablation dissociation (E0010).
The count encoding 1/(1+#fo) on BOS rests on one exploratory prompt (E0008).
The function was checked on 200 held-out random inputs plus part of seed 0 by hand, not on all 3125 possible inputs.
The lab's metric saturates at +-1 per prompt, so partial effects are fractions of prompts flipped rather than graded logit changes.
open_questions: What exactly does mlp0 write that the layer-1 heads need (a fo/ni indicator, or something the later MLPs read)?
Why are two MLP layers needed for the comparison; what intermediate does mlp1 hand to mlp2?
